component.name: classical-astrology-app
component.description: Classical Western astrology astronomical calculation service

properties.name: component_source
properties.value: deploy/requirements.lock (the file the image installs from) and backend/requirements-dev.lock, not the installed environment

properties.name: scope_semantics
properties.value: required = shipped and executed at runtime; optional = development and test only, not part of the AGPL corresponding source of the running program

properties.name: limitations
properties.value: PyPI packages only. It does not cover the Swiss Ephemeris data files, the vendored third-party source under third_party/, the base image's OS packages, or the IANA time zone database — each of which has its own evidence path and none of which are pip packages.
